question: When a front tyre punctures, the vehicle will

options.text: Stop suddenly.
Pull towards the side of the punctured tyre.
Move faster.

question: The higher the speed when negotiating a bend, the outward push of the centrifugal force will be

options.text: Smaller.
Greater.
Unchanged.

question: The stopping distance of a vehicle comprises the

options.text: Thinking distance and the reaction distance.
Reaction distance and the braking distance.
Skidding distance and the braking distance.

question: To brake safely on a wet road, you should

options.text: Apply both brakes together.
Apply intermittent (on/off) braking technique.
Depress the clutch pedal first followed by the brake pedal.

question: When making an emergency stop, you should

options.text: Avoid braking too hard to prevent the wheels from locking.
Step on the brake pedal as hard as possible.
Apply both the foot-brake and the hand-brake together.

question: When driving at night, you should use

options.text: Dipped headlight.
High beam.
Side lights only.

question: When you see a child standing beside the road, you should

options.text: Tap your horn to stop him from crossing.
Stop immediately to allow him to cross.
Slow down and be ready to stop.

question: When the amber traffic light is flashing continuously, you should

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Stop and wait for it to change to green.
Drive through it quickly.

question: When the 'amber' traffic light signal is flashing, you should

options.text: Carry on driving.
Slow down and look out for other vehicles before proceeding.
Call the police.

question: When you approach a bus signalling to move off from a bus stop, you should

options.text: Get past before it moves.
Flash your headlights as you approach.
Allow it to pull away.

question: You are following a large lorry on a wet road. Spray makes it difficult to see, you should

options.text: Put your headlights on high beam.
Speed up and overtake quickly.
Drop back until you can see better.

question: When caught in a slow moving bumper to bumper rush hour traffic, you should

options.text: Overtake all slow moving vehicles.
Be patient and follow the queue.
Weave in and out of available spaces to move forward.

question: The brake system within a vehicle

options.text: Requires little or no maintenance.
May be ignored as long as the vehicle stops safely.
Neither of these.

options.text: Use your brakes gently and early.
Brake harder.
Apply both the handbrake and foot brake together.

question: To prevent skidding when stopping your vehicle on a wet road, you should

options.text: Depress the clutch pedal and apply the brake pedal early.
Depress the brake pedal and apply the hand-brake together.

question: When you have caused inconvenience to others, you should

options.text: Just carry on driving as if nothing have happened.

Speed off quickly.

question: f your vehicle broke down on the expressway, you should

question: When you see a young cyclist in front, you should

options.text: Ride past it quickly.

question: How should you signal when you want to stop just after a side road to the left?

options.text: Give a slowing down arm signal before the junction.
